featured_reviews.name: Surbhi Agale
featured_reviews.review_text: My experience with Clc Abroad was disheartening. The management was chaotic, making the booking process a nightmare. Prices were exorbitant for the quality provided. Faculty seemed uninformed and unable to deliver effective instruction. There was little to no evaluation of our progress, leaving me feeling lost and unsupported throughout my study abroad journey.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text:
Thank you for sharing your feedback. We sincerely regret that your experience with CLC Abroad did not meet your expectations. Our priority is to provide high-quality guidance and support to every student, ensuring a smooth transition in their study abroad journey.

We would like to clarify that, as a consulting agency, we assist students in university shortlisting, course selection, accommodation services, and overall application guidance. Regarding accommodation, we help students find suitable housing options, but rental prices are determined by market standards and are beyond our control. We understand that you were looking for lower rates, but we always strive to provide the best available options within a reasonable budget.

Additionally, we noticed that a similar review was posted about our NSP branch 44 weeks ago. If there are unresolved concerns, we genuinely encourage you to reach out to us directly at admin@clcabroad.in so we can better understand your situation and address any issues. Our team is always available to assist and improve our services based on constructive feedback.

We appreciate your time and wish you the very best in your academic journey.

Best regards,
CLC Abroad Team
